Bringing the world together through live experiences

Eventbrite is a global self-service ticketing platform for live experiences that allows anyone to create, share, find and attend events that fuel their passions and enrich their lives. From music festivals, marathons, conferences, community rallies, and fundraisers, to gaming competitions and air guitar contests. Our mission is to bring the world together through live experiences.

It revolves around five pillars:","productRoadmap.section.1.title":"Accelerated product development","productRoadmap.section.2.bullets":"- Faster event creation: Creating an event is faster end-to-end: load times are down by -40%, and the interface stays responsive as you move through it. Loading times between each step will soon be significantly reduced too.","productRoadmap.section.2.para1":"Events are intense by nature, and the tools you rely on should always hold up when it counts. We're investing heavily in Eventbrite's reliability to ensure it's faster during key workflows and more stable during the most crucial moments on event day. We're also fixing the login issues that create stress for organizers and attendees who may find themselves locked out right as their event starts.","productRoadmap.section.2.title":"Platform reliability","productRoadmap.section.3.bullets":"- Question ordering at checkout: Whether you're selling tickets or running a free event, a complete registration often means capturing the right information at the right moment. Now you decide where your custom questions appear in the process—before or after the attendee confirms their spot. - Save before publishing: You could already save parts of your event as a draft, but we've now extended this capability to all steps in the event creation flow. - Check-in window: Set a specific time window for scanning tickets at the door. Useful for enforcing early access vs. general admission, or preventing entry before a set time. - Multi-slot scanning: For events with multiple overlapping time slots, operators can now scan attendees across all relevant slots at once from the organizer app, with no switching between sessions at the door.","productRoadmap.section.3.para1":"Managing an event requires a thousand small tasks and decisions. Eventbrite is becoming the tool that makes each one of them easier. This means a more intuitive and efficient platform, from check-in and reporting to refunds and payouts. We're also exploring the capabilities that matter most to creators running events at scale, such as direct SMS communication, reserved seating configurations, bulk attendee transfers, and more powerful waitlist management.","productRoadmap.section.3.title":"Creator tools","productRoadmap.section.4.bullet1":"- Creator profile page: A complete overhaul of your public profile—your storefront on Eventbrite. Now includes: a cover image, a media gallery where you can include pictures from past events, key stats, and links to your website and social channels. We're also working on a calendar of upcoming events.","productRoadmap.section.4.bullet2":"- Top Organizer badges: The creators who consistently show up and deliver deserve to be recognized. They will earn a badge visible across their profile and event listings: a signal of quality and trust for new attendees discovering the platform.","productRoadmap.section.4.bullet3":"- Event flyer tool: Generate a printable flyer with your event image, key details, and a QR code linking to your ticket page in multiple formats to be posted on venue windows, local boards, or anywhere you want to drive walk-up sales.","productRoadmap.section.4.bullet4":"- Higher-resolution event images: Your event listing photos now display at double the resolution. Your events look sharper everywhere they appear.","productRoadmap.section.4.para1":"Every creator on Eventbrite is working toward the same objective: a bigger audience, and one that keeps coming back. Beyond upgrading the reach and discovery tools already in place, we'll be working on the improvements that make that possible: marketing tools to promote your events on and off Eventbrite, attribution and conversion reporting, and better SEO for event listings so more people find you organically.","productRoadmap.section.4.title":"Event reach and discovery","productRoadmap.section.5.bullet1":"- Save to Apple Wallet / Google Wallet: From the mobile website, attendees can save their ticket to their phone's wallet in one tap.","productRoadmap.section.5.bullet2":"- Tickets available offline: Through the Eventbrite app, tickets are accessible without a connection and ready at the door.","productRoadmap.section.5.para1":"Attendees should always be able to find their ticket—regardless of how they signed up, or whether they have signal at the door. A smooth, reliable ticketing experience reduces stress for organizers and attendees alike. We're also working on automatic event update notifications: Registered attendees will be notified by email whenever you change the date, time, location, or key details of an event, with no manual message needed.","productRoadmap.section.5.title":"A modern ticketing experience","productRoadmap.section.6.bullets":"- Clearer confirmation emails: We polished various elements of the confirmation emails, such as the clarity of calls to action and the inclusion of relevant information like the answers to custom questions.","productRoadmap.section.6.para1":"Checkout is the most delicate and important part of the process. We're focused on making every step as simple and fast as possible to turn people's interest into action. We're also working on making add-ons more visible at checkout, so you can sell more in addition to your tickets.","productRoadmap.section.6.title":"Checkout","productRoadmap.seo.description":"Andrea Parodi shared Eventbrite's roadmap: reliability, creator tools, discovery, ticketing, and checkout—with new capabilities already live.","productRoadmap.seo.title":"Where Eventbrite Is Headed | Product Roadmap"},"env":{"ebHost":"www.eventbrite.com","stage":"Prod","pagePath":"/organizer/pricing/","tld":".com","locale":"en_US","ebLocale":"","localeInfo":{"locale":"en_US","tld":".com","country_code":"US","default_timezone":"America/Los_Angeles","locale_name":"United States","uses_language_subdirectory":false,"localized_language_name":"English (US)","default_language":"en-us","help_center_language":"en-us","press_blog_url":"/blog/press/","country_place_id":"85633793","is_default_for_tld":true},"serverUrl":"https://www.eventbrite.com/organizer/pricing/","slug":""},"__N_SSP":true},"page":"/organizer/[...slug]","query":{"slug":["pricing"]},"buildId":"Ep4pHocWmQxyqL6jY5Xxu","assetPrefix":"/mlp-cms","isFallback":false,"isExperimentalCompile":false,"dynamicIds":[61985,60876,36111,91423,56573,65759,10450,47491,14168,34636,47460],"gssp":true,"appGip":true,"scriptLoader":[]}</script></body></html>

mainEntity.name: What’s included when I use Eventbrite?

acceptedAnswer.text: When you host with Eventbrite, your event is featured on the world's largest and most trusted events marketplace, where millions of global ticket buyers discover things to do.You’ll have access to our complete toolkit, including integrated event ticketing, AI-powered event setup, secure payment processing, and powerful social media and email marketing tools—all designed to help you create a stand-out event. Learn more about our features here.

mainEntity.name: Is it free to use Eventbrite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, publishing your event on Eventbrite is free! Your attendees pay Ticketing Fees including a service fee and payment processing fee where applicable, unless you choose to cover them. If your event is free, no Ticketing Fees apply. Learn more about our Ticketing Fees here.There is an additional cost associated with running Eventbrite Ads or launching Instagram and Facebook ads through Eventbrite.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer special pricing for nonprofits?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we offer discounted Ticketing Fees on donation tickets, so more funds go directly to your cause. Additionally, qualifying nonprofits get 50% off our Pro plans so you can save on sending more marketing emails with Eventbrite.We’re committed to supporting nonprofits with tailored features to help you and your community thrive. Learn more here and discover how Eventbrite can empower your mission.

mainEntity.name: What if my event is free?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are no event ticket fees for free events. You can publish an unlimited number of free events on Eventbrite without any cost to you or your attendees. Our platform is completely free to use for events that do not charge for tickets, making it easy to manage registrations and RSVPs.

mainEntity.name: What support do I get with Eventbrite?

acceptedAnswer.text: All Eventbrite organizers have access to our comprehensive Help Center and educational resources to help make your event seamless.If you’re hosting a free event, you’ll have access to our email support, and you can subscribe to Pro for 24/7 chat support. For organizers with paid ticket events, we offer both email and 24/7 chat support.Finally, if you’re hosting large events, you can contact our sales team for dedicated phone support and strategic advising to help you maximize our platform.
Eventbrite Pro is a subscription add-on that offers extra daily email sends with our powerful marketing tool. Learn more here.
